oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:title: Audience Hall, 1888
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:creator: Egan, Christopher
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:description: The front view of Audience Hall. Construction began in 1883, and was finished in 1888. It contained classrooms, library, dormitories, cafeteria, administrative offices, faculty housing, infirmary, and auditorium. It could accommodate 1000 students. The name was changed to Virginia Hall in 1925.
oai_qdc:qualifieddc.dc:subject: African American universities and colleges; Buildings and grounds; Campus life
